description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Collective agreement between Ravi Marketing Services (Pvt.) Limited, Colombo 01 and other part United Tea, Rubber and Local Produce Workers Union, Colombo 05 (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a private company and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, working conditions, probation periods, attendance requirements, hours of work, and overtime regulations. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks governing labor relations and employment practices.
